newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Insight Enterprises a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Insight Enterprises a buy.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said analyst Tom Courtney has started coverage of Insight Enterprises Inc with a buy rating.
-- In a statement, Courtney said he expects the company to earn $1.35 a share in the fiscal year ending June 30, 1997, and $1.75 in fiscal 1998.
-- He has a 12-month price target of $43.
Insight shares were up 1-7/8 to 30-3/4 at midday.
-- Courtney believes the company, a business-to-business direct marketer of personal computer equipment and software, can grow earnings by 30 percent over the next several years.
